# Tasks Document: Production Deployment

## Phase 1: Docker Configuration

- [ ] 1. 创建 tenant-api Dockerfile
  - File: `docker/Dockerfile.tenant-api`
  - 实现多阶段构建（deps → builder → runner）
  - 使用 node:20-alpine 基础镜像，最终镜像 < 500MB
  - 使用非 root 用户运行，包含 HEALTHCHECK 指令
  - Purpose: 容器化 tenant-api 服务
  - _Leverage: 现有 package.json 构建配置_
  - _Requirements: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create multi-stage Dockerfile for tenant-api with deps/builder/runner stages, node:20-alpine base, non-root user, HEALTHCHECK instruction | Restrictions: Image size < 500MB, production dependencies only | Success: Image builds successfully, passes health check_

- [ ] 2. 创建 platform-service Dockerfile
  - File: `docker/Dockerfile.platform-service`
  - 复用 tenant-api 的构建模式
  - 配置正确的入口点和非 root 用户
  - Purpose: 容器化 platform-service 服务
  - _Leverage: `docker/Dockerfile.tenant-api`_
  - _Requirements: 1.1, 1.2_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create Dockerfile for platform-service following tenant-api pattern | Restrictions: Consistent with tenant-api Dockerfile | Success: Image builds and runs correctly_

- [ ] 3. 创建 docker-compose.yml
  - File: `docker-compose.yml`
  - 包含所有服务（tenant-api, platform-service, postgres, redis）
  - 配置网络隔离、volume 持久化、健康检查、启动顺序
  - Purpose: 开发环境容器编排
  - _Leverage: 现有服务配置_
  - _Requirements: 1.1, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create docker-compose.yml with all services, networks, volumes, health checks, depends_on | Restrictions: Development environment focus | Success: docker-compose up starts all services correctly_

- [ ] 4. 创建 docker-compose.prod.yml
  - File: `docker-compose.prod.yml`
  - 生产环境覆盖配置，包含副本数、资源限制、重启策略
  - Purpose: 生产环境容器编排
  - _Leverage: `docker-compose.yml`_
  - _Requirements: 1.4, 1.5_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create production docker-compose override with replicas, resource limits, restart policies | Restrictions: Production-grade configuration | Success: Production deployment stable and scalable_

## Phase 2: Nginx Reverse Proxy

- [ ] 5. 创建 Nginx 配置
  - File: `docker/nginx/nginx.conf`, `docker/nginx/conf.d/default.conf`
  - 配置 upstream 负载均衡、SSL/TLS、HTTP 重定向、静态文件缓存、gzip
  - Purpose: 反向代理和负载均衡
  - _Leverage: Nginx 最佳实践_
  - _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create Nginx config with upstream load balancing, SSL, redirect, caching, gzip | Restrictions: Security best practices | Success: Nginx routes traffic correctly with SSL_

- [ ] 6. 配置 SSL 证书管理
  - File: `scripts/generate-ssl-cert.sh`, `docker/nginx/ssl/README.md`
  - 支持自签名证书（开发）和 Let's Encrypt（生产）
  - 配置证书自动续期脚本
  - Purpose: SSL 证书生命周期管理
  - _Requirements: 2.1_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create SSL certificate scripts for self-signed (dev) and Let's Encrypt (prod), auto-renewal | Restrictions: Secure key handling | Success: Certificates generated and renewed automatically_

## Phase 3: CI/CD Pipeline

- [ ] 7. 创建 CI workflow
  - File: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
  - 包含代码检查、单元测试、构建验证、node_modules 缓存
  - PR 触发自动运行
  - Purpose: 持续集成流程
  - _Leverage: 现有 npm scripts_
  - _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create GitHub Actions CI workflow with lint, test, build, caching | Restrictions: PR-triggered | Success: CI passes on valid PRs, fails on issues_

- [ ] 8. 创建 Docker build workflow
  - File: `.github/workflows/docker-build.yml`
  - 构建 Docker 镜像，推送到容器仓库
  - 镜像标签策略（commit sha, tag），构建缓存优化
  - Purpose: 自动化镜像构建和发布
  - _Leverage: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`_
  - _Requirements: 3.3_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create Docker build workflow with image push, tagging strategy, build cache | Restrictions: Secure registry auth | Success: Images built and pushed on merge_

- [ ] 9. 创建 staging 部署 workflow
  - File: `.github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml`
  - main 分支自动部署，运行 E2E 测试，Slack 通知
  - Purpose: Staging 环境自动部署
  - _Leverage: `.github/workflows/docker-build.yml`_
  - _Requirements: 3.4, 3.5_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create staging deployment workflow with auto-deploy, E2E tests, Slack notification | Restrictions: main branch only | Success: Staging updated automatically after merge_

- [ ] 10. 创建 production 部署 workflow
  - File: `.github/workflows/deploy-production.yml`
  - Release tag 触发，需要手动批准，滚动更新，健康检查，自动回滚
  - Purpose: 生产环境安全部署
  - _Leverage: `.github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml`_
  - _Requirements: 3.5, 3.6_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create production deployment with manual approval, rolling update, health check, auto-rollback | Restrictions: Release tag trigger, approval required | Success: Zero-downtime production deployment_

## Phase 4: Environment Configuration

- [ ] 11. 创建多环境配置结构
  - File: `config/.env.example`, `config/.env.development`, `config/.env.staging`, `config/.env.production.example`
  - 配置加载优先级：环境变量 > Secrets Manager > .env 文件 > 默认值
  - Purpose: 统一配置管理
  - _Requirements: 4.1, 4.2_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Create environment config files with proper hierarchy and templates | Restrictions: No secrets in code | Success: App loads correct config per environment_

- [ ] 12. 创建配置验证模块
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/config/config.validation.ts`, `apps/tenant-api/src/config/config.module.ts`
  - 必需配置项检查、格式验证、缺失配置报错、加载日志
  - Purpose: 启动时配置校验
  - _Leverage: NestJS ConfigModule_
  - _Requirements: 4.3, 4.4_
  - _Prompt: Role: NestJS Developer | Task: Create config validation with required checks, format validation, clear error messages | Restrictions: Fail fast on missing config | Success: App fails with clear message on bad config_

- [ ] 13. 实现敏感配置管理
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/config/secrets.service.ts`
  - 支持环境变量、Docker secrets、GitHub Secrets
  - Purpose: 安全的敏感信息管理
  - _Leverage: NestJS ConfigService_
  - _Requirements: 4.2, 4.5_
  - _Prompt: Role: Backend Developer | Task: Create secrets service supporting env vars, Docker secrets, external secrets managers | Restrictions: Never log secrets | Success: Secrets loaded securely without exposure_

## Phase 5: Database Migration

- [ ] 14. 创建数据库迁移脚本
  - File: `scripts/db-migrate.sh`, `scripts/db-backup.sh`, `scripts/db-verify.sh`
  - Prisma migrate deploy 脚本，迁移前备份，迁移后验证，错误处理和回滚
  - Purpose: 安全的数据库迁移流程
  - _Leverage: Prisma CLI_
  - _Requirements: 5.1, 5.2, 5.3_
  - _Prompt: Role: DBA | Task: Create migration scripts with backup, deploy, verify, rollback capabilities | Restrictions: Zero data loss | Success: Migrations run safely with rollback option_

- [ ] 15. 集成迁移到 CI/CD
  - File: `.github/workflows/deploy-staging.yml` (update), `.github/workflows/deploy-production.yml` (update)
  - 部署前自动迁移，失败阻止部署，迁移日志，Slack 通知
  - Purpose: 自动化数据库迁移
  - _Leverage: `scripts/db-migrate.sh`_
  - _Requirements: 5.1, 5.4, 5.5_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Integrate migration into deployment workflows with failure handling and notifications | Restrictions: Block deploy on migration failure | Success: Migrations run automatically before deployment_

## Phase 6: Health Checks

- [ ] 16. 实现健康检查端点
  - File: `apps/tenant-api/src/health/health.controller.ts`, `apps/tenant-api/src/health/health.service.ts`, `apps/tenant-api/src/health/health.module.ts`
  - GET /health（基础）, GET /health/ready（就绪）, GET /health/live（存活）
  - 依赖服务状态检查（数据库、Redis、中间件）
  - Purpose: 容器健康检查支持
  - _Leverage: NestJS Terminus_
  - _Requirements: 6.1, 6.2_
  - _Prompt: Role: NestJS Developer | Task: Create health check endpoints with /health, /ready, /live, dependency checks | Restrictions: Fast response, accurate status | Success: Health endpoints reflect actual service state_

- [ ] 17. 集成健康检查到 Docker
  - File: `docker/Dockerfile.tenant-api` (update), `docker-compose.yml` (update)
  - Dockerfile HEALTHCHECK 指令，docker-compose 健康检查配置，启动等待依赖
  - Purpose: Docker 容器健康管理
  - _Leverage: Task 16_
  - _Requirements: 6.1, 6.3, 6.4, 6.5_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Add Docker HEALTHCHECK and compose health checks with dependency waiting | Restrictions: Appropriate intervals and thresholds | Success: Containers restart on unhealthy, proper startup order_

## Phase 7: Deployment Scripts

- [ ] 18. 创建部署脚本
  - File: `scripts/deploy.sh`
  - 一键部署，环境参数支持，部署前检查，部署后验证
  - Purpose: 简化部署流程
  - _Leverage: docker-compose, CI/CD workflows_
  - _Requirements: 7.1_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create deploy script with env params, pre-checks, post-verification | Restrictions: Idempotent execution | Success: Single command deploys to any environment_

- [ ] 19. 创建回滚脚本
  - File: `scripts/rollback.sh`
  - 快速回滚到上一版本，指定版本回滚，回滚前确认，日志记录
  - Purpose: 快速故障恢复
  - _Leverage: `scripts/deploy.sh`_
  - _Requirements: 7.2_
  - _Prompt: Role: DevOps Engineer | Task: Create rollback script with version selection, confirmation, logging | Restrictions: Under 5 minutes rollback | Success: Quick rollback with minimal downtime_

- [ ] 20. 创建部署文档
  - File: `docs/deployment-guide.md`, `docs/troubleshooting.md`
  - 部署指南，故障排查指南，配置说明，常见问题
  - Purpose: 运维文档支持
  - _Requirements: 7.3_
  - _Prompt: Role: Technical Writer | Task: Create deployment and troubleshooting documentation | Restrictions: Clear and actionable | Success: New team members can deploy following docs_

## Summary

| Phase | Tasks | Count |
|-------|-------|-------|
| Phase 1: Docker Configuration | 1-4 | 4 |
| Phase 2: Nginx Reverse Proxy | 5-6 | 2 |
| Phase 3: CI/CD Pipeline | 7-10 | 4 |
| Phase 4: Environment Configuration | 11-13 | 3 |
| Phase 5: Database Migration | 14-15 | 2 |
| Phase 6: Health Checks | 16-17 | 2 |
| Phase 7: Deployment Scripts | 18-20 | 3 |
| **Total** | | **20** |
